verify.title: Retire the layerxVerify 0x1012 retired executor
verify.replacement: drop the layerxVerify reference; after the plan height every method returns Error(string) LXP_MODULE_DISABLED, so the caller reads the committed header and an ICS23 proof through abci_query prove=true or eth_getProof instead

anchor.title: Retire the layerxAnchor 0x1014 checkpoint and guarantor surface
anchor.replacement: read finality from the block itself: the committed height and CometBFT commit, or eth_getBlockByNumber("finalized"); a state root comes from the committed app hash with a per-key ICS23 proof at that height

custody-claims.title: Retire the layerxCustody withdrawal claims, forced exit and deposit-root publication
custody-claims.replacement: a withdrawal is a native bank or layerxledger move at commit, an outward transfer is 0x1016 bridgeOut, and there is no forced exit or deposit-root publication after the plan height

custody-deposit.title: Retire the layerxCustody deposit escrow and asset and deposit views
custody-deposit.replacement: funding a kernel sub-account is a bank send to the derived sub-account address; asset facts come from bank 0x1001 name, symbol, decimals and supply and from pointerview 0x100A

exchange-intents.title: Retire the layerxExchange intent store, intent count and proof-carrying views
exchange-intents.replacement: read orders and positions through 0x1015 getOrder and getPosition (direct state reads); getIntent and requestSettlement return LXP_MODULE_DISABLED after the plan height while intentNonce stays

guarantor-runtime.title: Retire the guarantor runtime
guarantor-runtime.replacement: validators commit the sequencer-proposed block, so the guarantor process, its secrets and its provisioning step are removed

finality-authority.title: Retire the finality authority, evidence register, receipt authority, authority replica and sequencer handover
finality-authority.replacement: handover becomes the pinned leader list with standby takeover on the sequencer WAL; the sequencer receipt key is a governed parameter read from chain state at the receipt height

eth-relay.title: Retire the chain relay boundary of the kernel
eth-relay.replacement: no relay is needed because the sequencer is the chain; the relay process and its configuration are removed

da.title: Retire the dA bundle build, chunk proofs and verified DA storage
da.replacement: block data is the availability record; the DA build and storage are removed with the kernel daemon

replica.title: Retire the replica, authority replica and relay archive
replica.replacement: full and archive paxd nodes serve history; the standby follows the sequencer WAL; the relay archive entries are removed

idempotency.title: Retire the kernel idempotency table
idempotency.replacement: replay protection is the EVM account nonce plus the transaction hash; the hosted module drops its idempotency lookups

batch-seal.title: Retire the kernel batch seal, batch header roots, batch publish, batch WAL and kernel receipt signature
batch-seal.replacement: the pinned sequencer proposes the block and signs the receipt; the node sequencer WAL replaces the batch WAL

oracle-web-roots.title: Retire the unwired oracle adapter, oracle batch root, web adapter and web batch root
oracle-web-roots.replacement: no batch header exists after the merge; the oracle encoders linked by the perps intake are kept

feed-store.title: Retire the program state feed store
feed-store.replacement: readers use Cosmos events, PLX logs and the indexer keyed by (height, index) instead of a gap-free kernel sequence

fee-relay.title: Retire the fee-governance relay activity 0x00090008
fee-relay.replacement: the fee schedule changes through a governance-authority MsgUpdateFeeSchedule on the chain

replay-golden.title: Retire the kernel root replay golden
replay-golden.replacement: the replay golden and its targets are removed with the batch seal and replica; host determinism of the kept C modules is covered by the host determinism test

custody-credit.title: Retire the custody credit and light client
custody-credit.replacement: kernel balances are bank balances of derived sub-accounts, so no cross-domain credit exists; custodyproof/verify.go stays as the commit and header verifier

custody-disclosure.title: Retire the cross-domain custody credit disclosure
custody-disclosure.replacement: a deposit is a native balance, so the reserve account and its credit disclosure are removed

lni.title: Retire the lNI transport
lni.replacement: writes are eth_sendRawTransaction through the unified router and reads are eth_call on the precompile views or gRPC queries at a height

paxeer-verifier.title: Retire the layerx-paxeer-verifier crate
paxeer-verifier.replacement: verify the CometBFT commit and header at the height and read native per-key proofs; the bridge relayer keeps only a raw JSON-RPC call moved into its own crate

handover-client.title: Retire the client handover finality and sequencer trust history
handover-client.replacement: read the sequencer receipt key from chain state at the receipt height (governed parameter)

settlement-domain.title: Retire the settlement domain and export trust
settlement-domain.replacement: offline exports carry chain id 125 and the validator set at the height instead of a settlement domain

checkpoint-evidence.title: Retire the checkpoint certificates and guarantor attestations in client evidence
checkpoint-evidence.replacement: remove SettlementAnchored (agent-api major 2); CheckpointFinalised means block commit verified through the commit and header verifier

authorized-batch.title: Retire the human-authority authorized-batch facts
authorized-batch.replacement: verify the receipt against the block header and commit from the node at the receipt height instead of an authorized kernel batch

availability-fetch.title: Retire the availability fetch of kernel batches
availability-fetch.replacement: retrieve the block through eth_getBlockByNumber or the archive node

checkpoint-finality.title: Retire the kernel checkpoint-finality evidence in AI projections and program crates
checkpoint-finality.replacement: use block commit as finality plus an ICS23 proof of LXP program state at the height; retention timers key on block commit

envelope-signing.title: Retire the kernel ed25519 activity envelope signing for agents
envelope-signing.replacement: sign a secp256k1 EIP-1559 transaction through the same Signer trait; ed25519 stays only for bindLayerX and DID proofs

wire-codec.title: Retire the activity wire codec and its C differential
wire-codec.replacement: encode the operation as an EIP-1559 transaction with the existing RLP encoder; the differential runs against go-ethereum types

indexer-kernel-half.title: Retire the indexer kernel half
indexer-kernel-half.replacement: index the chain half only; kernel facts are chain events and PLX logs

layerxctl-port.title: Retire the layerxctl LNI port
layerxctl-port.replacement: talk to the chain over EVM JSON-RPC through the router; the binary, its build target and its images stay

intent-ingester.title: Retire the intent ingester
intent-ingester.replacement: 0x1015 executes synchronously in the transaction, so the ingester and its workspace, image, rollout and CI entries are removed

intent-vocabulary.title: Retire the layerx-intents precompile event vocabulary
intent-vocabulary.replacement: disclosure switches to the 0x1015 v2 method kinds; bridge kinds go because the bridge settles natively

dual-market-ids.title: Retire the dual market ids
dual-market-ids.replacement: one market id lives in the exchange store and 0x1015 getMarket reads it

protocol-adapter.title: Retire the programs protocol adapter
protocol-adapter.replacement: read program state and balances through the gRPC LXP Query/ProgramState and Query/ProgramBalances with ICS23 proofs

programs-ingress.title: Retire the gateway programs ingress mapping
programs-ingress.replacement: send the same payload bytes as an EVM transaction to layerxprograms 0x101D; the REST mapping is removed

program-events.title: Retire the kernel-backed lx_getProgramEvents
program-events.replacement: read eth_getLogs on PLX and xweb events plus LXP Query/ProgramEvents

storage-keeper.title: Retire the paxai-storage-keeper
storage-keeper.replacement: no reservation is needed; historical availability comes from archive nodes

kernel-web.title: Retire the kernel web module
kernel-web.replacement: program web requests go to the xweb module with origin 2; the xweb attestor set and threshold serve both origins and the xweb module escrow holds the fee

websearch-kernel-relay.title: Retire the x-websearch kernel relay and kernel 402LXP settlement
websearch-kernel-relay.replacement: watch and submit for origin 2 through eth_sendRawTransaction to the sequencer with the signed receipt; one EVM nonce per sender

account-naming.title: Retire the kernel account naming for web payments
account-naming.replacement: name the payer by its EVM address bound through addr 0x1004

receive-grant.title: Retire the kernel RECEIVE and GRANT for web payments
receive-grant.replacement: draw the payment through the layerxpay precompile at 0x101B

wallet-caps.title: Retire the lx_getWalletCaps
wallet-caps.replacement: read layerxpay getBudget, layerxledger getPayerGrant, layerxauth getGrant and xweb fee()

router-joins.title: Retire the router cross-domain joins
router-joins.replacement: keep the method names with one-source answers; response fields stay and kernel.available is derived true

wallet-two-domain.title: Retire the wallet gateway two-domain routes and jobs
wallet-two-domain.replacement: review and send an EVM transaction with the signed receipt; the lx review re-points to EVM review and the deposit action is removed

human-two-domain.title: Retire the human two-domain crates and journeys
human-two-domain.replacement: remove the deposit, withdraw, exit and binding hops; balances come from bank state and the explorer pages are the native explorer pages

explorer-kernel-views.title: Retire the explorer kernel-only views
explorer-kernel-views.replacement: native block and transaction pages show the data; the unified account folds into the native address page

mirror.title: Mirror kernel-checkpoint input
mirror.replacement: the mirror is kept and re-pointed: it publishes the committed header and app hash read from a full node at the mirrored height, and finality is block height and commit
